decision_rule: Full CPU build qualification only: exact v10 base and source diff plus all generated header hashes; linked llama-server contains adaptive environment, durable journal schema and poison markers; GGML_HIP OFF and backend DL OFF; hash-bound llama/ggml libraries resolve locally. Stop on validated full receipt; futility on build, identity or linkage failure, STOP or deadline. Smoke compiles actual transformed server translation unit and checks markers; no model, identity, speed or P9 verdict. Replacement v1 supervisor must record command exit reason and verified drain; full-build markers must be in the hash-bound local libllama-server-impl.so, with executable/cache/linkage bound and both UI build/fetch disabled. Numeric SONAME suffixes allowed only when exact local resolved component, unversioned alias and SONAME identities agree and artifacts remain hash-bound. Replacement after original r3 scratch reclamation; same exact source and qualification gates. Retain original output with --no-reclaim at filing until dependent CPU P9 completes.
notes: Replacement for reaped CPU r3 build consumed by CAFE-3 P9. File this build with file_result.py --no-reclaim: P9 requires its original build receipt, input inventory and compiled artifacts until P9 ends. No change to P9 policy or source; never reconstruct a deleted receipt.
